jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Core
jobs.description:
**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Manager, Core**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Director, Professional Services  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Core Implementation Manager (Core IM) is the sole owner of a portfolio of roughly 40+ First Due Core implementations, typically multi-module engagements. These standard and moderately complex projects carry real configuration complexity and frequently include CAD integration and historical data migration, requiring disciplined project management, strong customer command, and the ability to direct several internal specialists toward a single go-live date.

The Core IM owns the customer relationship and every project in the portfolio from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, and is accountable for planned duration, scope, risk, customer communication, and time to value. This is a fully autonomous role: you are self-directed on all delivery decisions inside the signed SOW and involve leadership only on commercial and relationship exceptions. Core delivery runs on a paired model: the Implementation Manager owns the project, the assigned Implementation Consultant owns module configuration and functional product depth, and Technical Services owns integration and data migration execution.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a full portfolio of roughly 40+ concurrent Core implementations from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, consistently holding planned duration below team goal.
* Keep Rocketlane, the system of record, current always (plans, timelines, milestones, task status, owners, and dates) so any colleague can open a project and know exactly where it stands. Complete documentation and exit gates on time, not retroactively.
* Lead customer kickoffs with command: set clear expectations, correct unrealistic assumptions in the room, and close with an agreed action list, owners, and dates. Adapt the agenda to each agency’s politics and readiness based on Discovery.
* Run a progress cadence of at least bi-weekly check-ins on new acquisition projects and monthly on upsells, using each one to find and remove the real blocker rather than read status.
* Tailor each plan to the agency’s operational reality, including shift patterns, governance and approval cycles, budget calendars, and go-live blackout windows. Own multi-module sequencing, phasing, and dependency decisions across the platform.
* Direct and sequence the work of Implementation Consultants, Technical Services, Integrations, Support, and Product without direct authority, securing commitment on dates. Module configuration is owned by the assigned Implementation Consultant.
* Proactively surface product gaps, process gaps, communication silos, and methodology friction to leadership with supporting specifics and a proposed fix, and help own internal improvement efforts.

### **Qualifications:**

* This is a remote role, but the person hired must live in the US.
* 5+ years of experience managing customer-facing SaaS implementations (or 3+ years plus a master’s degree), including a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, including how fire, EMS, or law enforcement agencies operate and how decisions are made inside them.
* Demonstrated ownership of project plans, timelines, risk management, escalation recovery, and scope discipline, including change orders, on projects with multiple internal contributors.
* Proven ability to drive delivery outcomes through matrixed contributors without direct reporting authority.
* Working data literacy: comfortable reading record counts, spotting bad mappings, and assessing integration and migration risk.
* Experience with implementation project management tooling.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise, actionable follow-ups, status reporting an executive stakeholder can act on, and delivering bad news early with a recommended path.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working to billable utilization targets in a professional services organization.
* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management credential.
* Experience with fire, EMS, or law enforcement records management, CAD systems, or emergency services software.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce.
* Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment with evolving methodology and tooling.

**For US-based Roles**  
All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E-Verify.  
  
**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  
This role is fully remote with minimal travel expectations at this time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  
  
**Working at First Due**  
First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. Visit www.firstdue.com to learn more.  
  
If you are a resident of a state requiring wage transparency, please reach out to people@firstdue.com for a reasonable estimate of annual base compensation and any eligible incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered to successful candidates for roles may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory criteria including but not limited to relevant professional experience, geographic location, knowledge, skills, and abilities. *This range will be reviewed on a regular basis.*  
  
First Due is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status or class. We are committed to promoting an environment of respect, acceptance, diversity and inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Discrimination and harassment of any type in any form will not be tolerated.  
  
When you apply for a role at Locality Media, LLC d/b/a First Due, we collect personal information such as identifiers (e.g., name, email, phone number), professional and employment information, education information, and information you provide in your application materials. We use this information to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you, and manage our recruiting process. We may share this information with our service providers who assist with recruiting and background screening. We do not sell or share applicant personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. We retain applicant information in accordance with our data retention policies. California residents have rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the CPRA. For more information, please review our Candidate Privacy.

jobs.title: Senior Accounting Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Uplinq**

Uplinq is the AI-powered bookkeeping and tax automation platform built for small business owners. We’re re-engineering how entrepreneurs manage their finances, replacing manual bookkeeping, rules, and spreadsheets with intelligent automation that delivers real-time clarity and control.

We’re a Series A startup backed by top investors, growing fast. Our team is lean, execution-focused, and allergic to fluff. We measure success in demos booked, pipelines created, and revenue influenced.

**Individual applicants residing in the US only**  
  
**About the role**

As a Senior Onboarding Accounting Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for new Uplinq clients — guiding them through system setup, data clean-up, and account activation.

This is a high-touch, high-volume role: you'll juggle a large, active portfolio of clients at different onboarding stages, which means the job rewards people who communicate early and often, adapt quickly when something isn't working, and hold themselves accountable for outcomes rather than just effort.

The right candidate will have a magnetic presence on calls and an excitement about interaction with small business owners. The ideal candidate is a person the clients look forward to speaking with, someone who makes them feel confident in the investment they’ve made when choosing Uplinq.

**What you'll do**

* Lead daily client meetings to gather financial data, clarify scope, and build trust from the first call — earning it through rapport, clarity, and follow-through, not just technical accuracy.
* Set up and configure Uplinq and QuickBooks Online accounts, including resolving integration and access issues (Plaid connections, payroll, revenue processors, inventory systems, etc) so systems sync cleanly from day one.
* Compare signed proposals to actual client needs in the first call, and flag scope or pricing mismatches immediately — to sales, to your manager, and directly to the client — rather than letting a gap surface later and erode trust.
* Manage a high volume of onboarding timelines and deliverables simultaneously, and proactively speak up when your workload or a specific account is at risk of falling behind, so it can be addressed before it becomes a bigger problem.
* Troubleshoot setup and data issues using sound accounting judgment, and treat mistakes as fast information rather than something to hide — surface them quickly, learn from them, and adjust.
* Find workarounds to keep stalled onboardings moving — manual data entry when a feed breaks, alternate document paths, creative scheduling — because an on-time, good-enough solution beats a stalled account waiting for a perfect one.
* Collaborate with Sales, Initialization, Accounting, and Tax teams to resolve handoff gaps, own your part of the process end-to-end, and transition accounts smoothly into ongoing support.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years in a client-facing accounting or onboarding role, ideally in public or multi-client accounting firm as Senior Associate level or higher
* 6+ years of daily QuickBooks use including Online setup, integrations, and troubleshooting (not desktop).
* Strong working knowledge of both cash- and accrual-based accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 25+ active client relationships at once without letting communication or follow-through slip — someone who escalates early, adapts on the fly, and takes ownership of outcomes rather than absorbing pressure silently.
* A warm, confident, and memorable presence with clients — someone who builds real rapport fast, puts anxious business owners at ease, and makes a technical process feel personal rather than transactional.
* Comfortable having direct conversations with clients about scope and pricing when what they signed doesn't match what they need, and willing to admit and correct course quickly when something's off.

**Why Join Us**

* Competitive pay + health, dental, vision, 401(k), and life insurance
* Remote-first and flexible work culture
* Clear path for career growth in a fast-growing firm
* Modern tech stack and automation-first mindset
* Supportive, collaborative team with strong systems and documentation

Compensation Range: $75,000-$85,000

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 85,000 USD per year(Remote)

jobs.title: SALES PERFORMANCE IMPLEMENTATION SPECIALIST
jobs.description:
Sales Performance Implementation Specialist

**NORTH POINT SALES GROUP**  
**Remote — United States | Contract | Commission-Based**  
**Potential Annual Earnings: $100,000–$250,000+**  
**Training and Ongoing Support Provided**

NORTH POINT SALES GROUP is seeking an experienced **Sales Performance Implementation Specialist** to work directly with established companies that want to improve the performance of their sales organizations.

This is a remote contract position open to qualified candidates throughout the United States.

The position is designed for an experienced sales professional who understands how to evaluate sales performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and help companies implement practical changes that improve productivity, effectiveness, and revenue.

This is not simply a sales-training position.

We are looking for someone who can identify what is limiting performance, recommend practical solutions, and then help put those improvements into operation.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Depending on the client and scope of the engagement, responsibilities may include:

* Evaluate current sales performance
* Work directly with sales representatives and sales leadership
* Identify performance weaknesses and opportunities
* Improve prospecting and lead-development activity
* Strengthen sales presentations
* Improve objection handling and closing effectiveness
* Improve follow-up procedures
* Improve pipeline management
* Review CRM utilization
* Improve sales accountability
* Establish or improve performance measurements
* Review sales processes and systems
* Coach and develop salespeople
* Work with sales managers and leadership
* Help implement recommended improvements
* Monitor implementation progress and results
* Participate in executive client conversations when appropriate
* Help identify additional opportunities within existing client relationships

The emphasis is on **implementation**.

We are not looking for someone who simply conducts a seminar, distributes training materials, and leaves.

We are looking for someone capable of working directly with a client until the agreed improvements are actually being put into practice.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate has substantial experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Sales Management
* B2B Sales
* Sales Consulting
* Sales Training and Coaching
* Fractional Sales Leadership
* Sales Operations
* Business Development
* Sales Process Improvement
* Sales Performance Management
* Executive-Level Client Relationships

You should be comfortable working directly with:

* Business owners
* CEOs and senior executives
* Sales managers
* Sales representatives
* Established sales organizations

Strong communication, judgment, leadership, problem-solving ability, and practical sales experience are essential.

We are especially interested in people who can evaluate a sales situation objectively and then work hands-on with the client to improve it.

CLIENT OPPORTUNITIES

NORTH POINT SALES GROUP provides **qualified client opportunities and warm leads**.

You will not be expected to build your entire client base from scratch.

Our senior team can participate in developing, presenting, and closing larger client engagements.

Your primary responsibility is to help ensure that the work we agree to perform is implemented professionally and effectively.

TRAINING AND SUPPORT

**Training and ongoing support are provided.**

You will work directly with the NORTH POINT SALES GROUP team and receive support with:

* Client evaluation
* Sales-performance analysis
* Engagement scope
* Implementation planning
* Performance measurement
* Executive communication
* Client strategy
* Problem solving
* Ongoing engagement management

You will not simply be assigned a client and expected to figure everything out on your own.

We will help you understand our approach, our expectations, the scope of each engagement, and the results we are working to produce.

REMOTE WORK

This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States.

Most client and team interaction can be handled through phone, video meetings, CRM, and other online collaboration tools.

If a client engagement requires in-person participation, **NORTH POINT SALES GROUP will cover approved travel expenses associated with that visit**. Those costs are handled as part of the client engagement and are not expected to come out of the specialist’s compensation.

COMPENSATION

This is a **commission-based contract position**.

**Potential annual earnings: $100,000–$250,000+**, depending on the number, size, scope, and level of responsibility associated with the client engagements in which you participate.

Larger and more comprehensive implementation engagements can provide substantially greater income opportunities.

**There is no artificial earnings ceiling. Strong performers who successfully manage multiple substantial engagements may earn more than $250,000 annually.**

ABOUT NORTH POINT SALES GROUP

NORTH POINT SALES GROUP works with established companies to identify additional performance potential within their existing sales organizations and implement improvements designed to increase productivity, effectiveness, and sales revenue.

Our work can involve:

* Sales performance
* Sales leadership
* Prospecting and lead development
* Sales presentations
* Pipeline management
* CRM
* Forecasting
* Accountability
* Performance measurement
* Compensation
* Recruiting
* Onboarding
* Sales systems
* Sales team development

Our focus is on **implementation and measurable improvement**, not simply recommendations.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your resume along with a **1–2 minute selfie video**.

The purpose of the video is simply to give us a sense of how naturally and professionally you present and communicate, since this position involves direct interaction with business owners, executives, sales managers, and sales professionals.

For the video, please deliver the following short script in your own natural speaking style:

**“Hello, this is [your name] with NORTH POINT SALES GROUP. We work with established companies to identify additional sales-performance potential within their existing sales organizations. Our focus is on helping companies improve sales productivity, effectiveness, and revenue. I’m reaching out to see whether increasing sales performance is something your organization would be open to discussing.”**

We are not looking for a memorized or overly polished performance. We simply want to hear how you sound delivering a professional business message.

The video does not need to be professionally produced. A simple video recorded on your phone is fine.

Please include a link to the video with your application.

**Applications submitted without the requested video may not be considered.**

Pay: $100,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

The Training Specialist will report to the Senior Manager of Operations Quality & Training will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, coordination, and facilitation of the Operations training and development program. The Training Specialist will work in collaboration with Operations leadership and the executive team to support key business and people objectives. They will work on business-specific strategic imperatives that focus on assessing and diagnosing organizational needs, driving change, and delivering best-in-class training solutions to support the business strategy. The right candidate will be driven by the opportunity to learn, grow and push their professional boundaries.  
  
**JOB QUALIFICATIONS: KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES**  
  
The Training Specialists’ responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  

* Works with the Manager of Operations Training to develop an end-to-end training roadmap and training calendar, as per business needs, in association with department leaders to deliver appropriate and effective training.
* Ensures execution of training policy across a diverse workforce including diverse locations and skill sets. Elevate skill levels by effective coordination and presentation of training and development programs.
* Assesses training needs, defines training requirements, and develops training plan which contains measurement of success to support Operations.
* Design, develop and implement training content using different learning modalities for internal employees and external customers in partnership with internal subject matter experts.
* Creates different learner journeys based on job roles, competency levels and training needs.
* Create content that addresses skill and knowledge gaps, need for improvement, or change in processes.
* Owns, evaluates, and constantly improves the New Hire Orientation. Collaborate with each of the operational areas to create content for Department specific New Hire Orientations.
* Along with business partners, identify individual and team weaknesses and work with subject matter experts to create and deliver refresher training in partnership with Quality and department leaders.
* Conducts training for new hires and refresher training across all levels of the operations areas.
* Track training progress, monitor access, and consistently strive to improve effectiveness of training delivered to ensure incorporation of taught skills and techniques into employees work behavior.
* Develops and implement effective ways to conduct training and make it fun through workshops, training retreats, gamification etc.
* Support the development and implementation of change enablement strategies, processes, and methodologies, including change management and training. Provides guidance and support for all change enablement initiatives and/or corporate projects that contain aspects of change. Optimizes key business processes by providing product, technical and compliance knowledge training.
* Oversees all lesson plans for each application by ensuring quality assurance checks are in place and that training captures both system and workflow process.
* Partner closely with other Application Team leads and ensure training needs are met and executed efficiently.
* Updates management and stakeholders during regular meetings on training program status and updates.
* Stay abreast of the new trends and tools in employee learning and development.

WHAT WILL YOU LEARN IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS:

* Integra Partner’s business model and its role in providing health care services to our customers
* In-depth understanding of Integra Partner’s business processes and technical systems that support our core operations
* Working knowledge of Eloomi, Integra Partner’s new learning management tool
* Understanding and alignment of the training department’s strategic and tactical goals with organizational and business priorities

WHAT WILL YOU ACCOMPLISH IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS:

* Develop and implement new hire and refresher training programs for select operational areas
* Implement and maintain Integra’s new learning management software
* Develop best-in-class learning content based on different learner personas
* Implement and track learning metrics to measure the effectiveness of the training program
* Develop key processes to use feedback from training assessments, the quality assurance team and leaders to design individual training plans to help improve employee performance

**EDUCATION:**

* BS or BA Degree in Business Management, Human Resources, Engineering, Education and Learning, Applied Behavioral Science, Organizational Development, or related field required, or 2 Years of experience in training & development in lieu of degree.

**EXPERIENCE:**

* 2+ Years of experience in Training & Development, healthcare experience preferred in a training environment.
* Knowledge and practical experience within the healthcare industry, including pre-authorization, utilization reviews, medical claims processing, healthcare operations workflows, and regulatory/compliance requirements.
* Proven experience in designing multiple training events in a corporate setting.
* Extensive knowledge of instructional design theory and learning principles.
* Familiarity with traditional and modern training methods, tools, and techniques.
* Experience training for call center or Operations areas in the health care industry preferred.
* Adequate knowledge of learning management software. Experience using training tools such as Articulate or Captivate and learning management solutions preferred.
* Experience using learning management software such as Eloomi preferred.
* Understanding of career development and employee engagement practices and experience measuring engagement and implementing practices to increase organizational performance.
* Demonstrated enthusiasm about the growth and development of people to reach their full potential through skill building experiences.
* Ability to execute and thrive in a fast paced, changing, matrixed and highly collaborative environment.
* Must be able to manage large scale, complex projects for the company on time, within budget and with agreed upon deliverables.
* Strong facilitation, communication, presentation and training skills.
* Ability to lead and motivate others.
* Ability to interact effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Experience from consultation to development and implementation of initiatives.
* Self-motivated, entrepreneurial attitude with a willingness to do whatever it takes to get things done.

**SALARY:** 65,000.00/Annually

**Benefits Offered**

* Competitive compensation and annual bonus program
* 401(k) retirement program with company match
* Company-paid life insurance
* Company-paid short term disability coverage (location restrictions may apply)
* Medical, Vision, and Dental benefits
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Parental Leave
* Sick Time
* Paid company holidays and floating holidays
* Quarterly company-sponsored events
* Health and wellness programs
* Career development opportunities

**Remote Opportunities**

We are actively seeking new colleagues in: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

**Our Story**

Founded in 2005, Integra Partners is a leading national durable medical equipment, prosthetic, and orthotic supplies (DMEPOS) network administrator. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for the communities we serve by reimagining access to in-home healthcare. We connect Payers, Providers, and Members through innovative technology and streamlined workflows affording Members access to top local Providers and culturally competent care. By focusing on transparency, accountability, and adaptability, we help deliver better health outcomes and more efficient management of complex healthcare benefits.

With a location in Michigan plus a remote workforce across the United States, Integra has a culture focused on collaboration, teamwork, and our values: One Team, Drive Results, Push the Boundaries, Value Others, and Build Community. We’re looking for energetic, talented, and dedicated individuals to join our team. See what opportunities we have available; there may be a role for you to engage in a challenging yet rewarding career in healthcare. We look forward to learning more about you.

Integra Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: Training Specialist/Instructional Developer 2
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Training Specialist/Instructional Developer to support the analysis, design, and development of U.S. Navy training products. This position will be located in Pensacola, FL, and will be a fully remote position.

Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will lead front-end instructional design activities and work directly with Government Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to transform technical information and training requirements into structured, effective instructional content. This position will be responsible for instructional analysis, learning-objective development and mapping, scriptwriting, storyboard development, and coordination with multimedia developers to ensure final products meet applicable NAVEDTRA standards. Key responsibilities include:

* Conduct front-end instructional analysis to identify training requirements, performance needs, content requirements, and appropriate instructional approaches.
* Analyze source documentation, existing curriculum, technical materials, and SME input to support development and revision of Navy training products.
* Develop, review, revise, and map learning objectives to applicable training requirements.
* Write clear, technically accurate instructional scripts for interactive and web-based training.
* Develop detailed storyboards that communicate instructional content, learner interactions, graphics, animations, media, navigation, assessments, and developer instructions.
* Collaborate directly with Government SMEs to validate technical accuracy and instructional content.
* Facilitate SME reviews and incorporate adjudicated feedback into instructional products.
* Ensure instructional products conform to applicable NAVEDTRA standards and Government requirements.
* Apply sound instructional design principles, adult-learning concepts, and systematic instructional development methodologies.
* Organize technical information into logical, learner-centered instructional sequences.
* Design appropriate instructional interactions, practice opportunities, knowledge checks, and assessment strategies.
* Collaborate closely with multimedia and technical developers throughout the development lifecycle.
* Review developed multimedia products against approved storyboards to ensure instructional intent has been accurately implemented.
* Participate in internal peer reviews, quality assurance reviews, Government reviews, and product validation activities.
* Revise instructional materials based on Government, SME, QA, and testing feedback.
* Maintain traceability among source requirements, learning objectives, instructional content, and assessments.
* Support production schedules and ensure assigned instructional products are completed in accordance with project milestones.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's with 2-5 years (or commensurate experience)

Required Skills and Experience

* Clearance Required: Secret
* Relevant professional experience sufficient to meet or exceed applicable contract labor-category requirements.
* Demonstrated experience performing instructional systems design, curriculum development, or training development.
* Experience conducting instructional analysis and translating technical requirements into effective learning solutions.
* Demonstrated experience developing measurable learning objectives.
* Strong scriptwriting and storyboard-development skills.
* Experience collaborating directly with technical SMEs to develop and validate instructional content.
* Ability to analyze complex technical information and present it clearly for an intended learner population.
* Knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and training-development methodologies.
* Strong writing, editing, organization, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with instructional designers, software developers, multimedia developers, Government personnel, and SMEs.
* Ability to manage multiple products and deadlines in a structured production environment.
* Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust access necessary to access Navy networks and training systems.

Preferred Skills and Experience

* Previous experience developing training for the U.S. Navy, Department of Defense, or another Federal Government organization.
* Working knowledge of NAVEDTRA curriculum and training-development standards.
* Experience developing Interactive Multimedia Instruction or web-based training.
* Experience writing detailed storyboards for implementation in tools such as Adobe Captivate.
* Familiarity with SCORM-compliant training and Learning Management Systems.
* Experience developing knowledge checks, assessments, and other instructional evaluation instruments.
* Familiarity with formal Government curriculum review, quality assurance, and acceptance processes.
* Experience working within multidisciplinary teams consisting of SMEs, instructional designers, multimedia developers, programmers, and Government stakeholders.

Posted Salary Range: USD $65,932.00 - USD $65,932.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: EHR Analyst, Senior
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** EHR Analyst, Senior  
**Department:** Ambulatory Application  
**Location:** Riedman - Remote  
**Hours Per Week:** 40  
**Schedule:** Full-Time, Day-Shift, Monday to Friday, (8 am - 4:00 pm)

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  

* Minimum two (2) to five (5) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

LICENSURE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  

* Current Epic Certification.
